name: Jungle
description:
'''Jungle''' are a British band formed in early 2013 by London-based [[musical production|producers]] Josh Lloyd-Watson and Tom McFarland. Jungle have released five studio albums: ''[[Jungle (Jungle album)|Jungle]]'' (2014), which was shortlisted for the [[Mercury Prize]]; ''[[For Ever (Jungle album)|For Ever]]'' (2018); ''[[Loving in Stereo]]'' (2021); ''[[Volcano (Jungle album)|Volcano]]'' (2023); and [[Sunshine (Jungle album)|''Sunshine'']] (2026). The first two albums were released through [[XL Recordings]] while the latter three via their independent label Caiola Records.

In late 2023, having worked as a main musical contributor on ''Loving in Stereo'', and co-writing every track with founding member J Lloyd on the album ''Volcano'', it became official that Lydia Kitto joined Lloyd-Watson and McFarland as a full-time member after their [[Brit Awards|BRIT]] nomination for Group of the Year.
